build_TransitionModel: build a TransitionModel with x, y, z belief and state sizes for a denoised MDP agent
create_LatentState: create a LatentState dataclass with x, y, z belief and state tensors for world model tracking
run_posterior_rsample: run posterior_rsample on a TransitionModel with actions, observations, and rewards over a time sequence
run_posterior_rsample_one_step: run posterior_rsample_one_step on a TransitionModel with a single action and observation to get posterior latent state
run_x_prior_rsample_one_step: run x_prior_rsample_one_step on a TransitionModel with a single action to get the x prior without posterior
